title: ••Laser Gate
caption: ••Laser Gate (V)
game_text: Deploy between two non-exterior Death Star sites. Unless aboard a Lift Tube, for opponent’s character to pass opponent must first lose 1 Force. At adjacent sites: weapon destiny draws are -1, your Force generation may not be limited, and opponent’s characters are deploy +2.
lore: Security corridors are guarded by a grid of laser emplacements which can be activated upon demand to seal off sensitive areas from intrusion.
